title: Virgin Money - Bank accounts (BOQ)
body:
O.P.
Has anyone else signed up to try the new Virgin Money banking and savings products?
The bank accounts themselves are issued by BOQ (Bank of Queensland). From what I can see it looks like they have issued other products with other retail banks in the past including some home loans with Macquarie Bank.
I received my Visa Debit card today.
Apparently, because they are trading as "a division of BOQ", they are not classified as a neobank. They're more of a "Direct Bank" like ING, ME, Macquarie, UBank.
Some interesting notes: No desktop banking site Single network card (no eftpos support – Visa only, Visa Platinum Debit issued with all their accounts) Apple Pay, Google Pay and Samsung Pay support 'out of the box' (can add card to digital wallet and use prior to receipt of the physical card) Supports mobile and email address for PayID. Gives you an @virginmoney.com.au address as an alternative to using your existing email address to register as a PayID
I think we have already worked out that they're covered under BOQ under the government deposit guarantee.
Basically, it's a digital bank that's a division of BOQ and wipes the floor with BOQ in terms of their app and technology/support offerings. I don't mind it but I'm not in a hurry to switch either.
